scenes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: first of three inline paintings for Kanji Trail chapter 2, The Bridge in the Mist; place after paragraph 0. Show Aoi following Kohaku along a narrow cedar-forest path in the evening mist, holding a softly glowing paper lantern at chest height. Ren walks close beside her and turns at a bend to look back, where the stone wall and village have disappeared behind pale mist. Kohaku leads ahead in his simple fox mask. Long soft bands of daylight remain in the treetops; broad damp leaves and tree trunks frame the path. Keep expressions thoughtful and calm. Palette of muted indigo, sage cedar green, warm ivory mist, muted teal and a small ochre lantern glow. Match paragraph 0 only. No festival stalls, no bridge, no text, lettering, border or watermark. Avoid busy foliage and rich cover-level brush texture.
